scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @gear-drop/api" "npm run dev -w @gear-drop/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev -w @gear-drop/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev -w @gear-drop/web
scripts.check: npm run build:contracts && npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck:tooling && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run check:architecture && npm test -w @gear-drop/api
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:contracts && npm run test:integration -w @gear-drop/api
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w @gear-drop/api && npm run build -w @gear-drop/web
